name: Picture
label: Short Span
lede: Natal Zaks made sunlit house in Aarhus for a decade under other names. In 2026 he put out two double LPs of dub techno as Picture, and the second drew an 8.2 from Pitchfork.

eras.title: Eleven guys and a bunker
eras.text: Aarhus house began as friends buying records together. Natal Zaks sat in the middle of it, running a label with his brother Milán and releasing as Central.

years.big: "It was the peak, and it was also what kicked off the label."
q: We don't plan, we just do.
years.src: XLR8R: Labels We Love, Regelbau · Jaeger Oslo: What's in a name, a Q&A with Central
years.h: Regelbau starts as a Facebook group for record diggers
years.p: Natal Zaks on a New Year's party in the WWII bunker the group rented from the state, which drew about double the crowd they expected. Eleven members in all, four of them core.
years.xp:
The group met on a Facebook group for people interested in record digging, then took the bunker for parties. Per XLR8R, the four core members were Christoffer Kejlstrup (C.K.), Mathias Okholm (Manmade Deejay), Milán Zaks (DJ Sports) and Natal Zaks (Central). The first release, RB01, came in summer 2015: three sunny house cuts with almost no information around them.

Zaks says it began as a collective, a team effort, and ended up a label: "Now it's a label."

years.h: Fresh Context arrives on Help, the label he runs with his brother
years.p: Natal Zaks records as Central; Help Recordings is co-run with Milán Zaks, who records as [[DJ Sports|e546aa8d-31e3-4874-9420-ffba69d7ff16]].

yt: Central, Boiler Room x Dekmantel Festival DJ set
years.h: Dekmantel in Amsterdam picks up Central for two Political Dance EPs
years.p: Political Dance #1 and #2 carry Natal Zaks's house records beyond the Aarhus circle.

eras.title: The producer behind the voice
eras.text: Zaks keeps releasing under a string of names, puts out a double LP as Central, opens a club, and ends up co-producing Erika de Casier's records for 4AD.

years.src: Inverted Audio: DJ Sports talks up debut album Modern Species
years.h: Milán Zaks's Modern Species double 12-inch comes out on Firecracker
years.p: Releasing as [[DJ Sports|e546aa8d-31e3-4874-9420-ffba69d7ff16]] on Edinburgh's Firecracker Recordings, he sells it out fast; Inverted Audio reports a repress is planned.
years.xp: Milán describes Regelbau as a collective that shared a place and threw parties. In 2017 he named his brother Natal, Man-dee, pH 1 and Samir as the people sharing studio space.

years.src: Jaeger Oslo: Album of the week, Central, Om Dans · Passive/Aggressive: Central interview and mix
years.h: Jaeger Oslo makes Om Dans its album of the week
years.p: Central's double LP runs dance cuts into ambient interludes, and the review sets its minimalism next to Robert Hood's Minimal Nation.
years.xp:
Jaeger Oslo hears layer on layer building a dense subterranean void. Passive/Aggressive, interviewing Zaks in June 2019, calls it his second album, on Help, and notes he had spent about three months in Tel Aviv making new material.

The same year he is credited as a collaborator on [[Erika de Casier|071409d0-ce21-4f03-a111-aec4dbc1590d]]'s debut, Essentials.

years.cap: Natal Zaks in a Super shirt
years.h: Central takes over Tape's old room in Aarhus and calls it Super
years.p: A bar, record shop, radio station and events space, run by the Regelbau team.
years.xp:
Tape closed, and the Regelbau team put together a crew to take the venue over. Truants reports Super opened in 2020, with a DJ school, workshops and feedback events for producers alongside the parties.

Zaks's pitch for the room: "We like it small and cozy, intimate and warm."

years.src: Wikipedia: Sensational (Erika de Casier album) · Bandcamp Daily: Erika de Casier Lets Loose on Sensational · Truants: Truancy Volume 281, Central
years.h: Natal Zaks co-produces Erika de Casier's Sensational for 4AD
years.p: 4AD releases the album. Zaks had worked on her 2019 debut Essentials; he also remixes under the name El Trick.
years.xp:
Wikipedia says de Casier co-produced Sensational with Zaks. Bandcamp Daily credits him with the upbeat, danceable beats on Busy and Better Than That. Pitchfork put the album at number 40 on its 50 best albums of 2021.

Zaks told Truants that each of the two albums took about a year: the first built around her voice, the second from demos she brought.

eras.title: Same producer, more names
eras.text: As Central, Picture, Palta, Maizena and others, Zaks releases at a pace that keeps his label busy, and keeps working with de Casier.

q: Everything I make doesn't have a name until I release it.
years.src: CLONE distribution: Picture (AKA Central), Metric EP · Jaeger Oslo: What's in a name, a Q&A with Central
years.h: Natal Zaks tries the name Picture on Kalahari Oyster Cult
years.p: Metric is four tracks (Rul, Silke, Forskudt, Targil), the earliest Picture release in our sources.
years.xp: CLONE lists it as Picture (AKA Central), catalogue OYSTER37, and describes four bouncy joints in the classic Aarhus style. Zaks says he starts by dropping every concept, and that nothing he makes has a name until release.

years.src: Discogs: Central, Up And Down · Resident Advisor: Picture, Uuuuuuuu (review)
years.h: Up & Down spends 2018 to 2021 in the making
years.p: Central's eight-track double LP for Help Recordings, recorded and produced in Aarhus and mastered by Simon Davey.
years.xp: RA's Bella Aquilina later points to Lost Touch, from this record, as the place where traces of Zaks's dub techno interest already showed. Discogs lists it as HELP020.

years.src: Wikipedia: Still (Erika de Casier album) · Sound Shelter: The many faces of Natal Zaks (Central)
years.h: Natal Zaks mixes every track on Erika de Casier's Still
years.p: 4AD credits him with programming and studio musicianship too.
years.xp: Central also puts out Plask and Livet on Help this year, per Sound Shelter's list of his aliases and releases.

eras.title: Vowels and pressure
eras.text: Two double LPs in five months, both on a Sheffield label that only started in 2025. The house grooves are gone; the low end and the reverb carry it.

years.src: Inverted Audio: Review, Picture, Eeeeeee · note.com: Emerging Dub Techno Label Short Span
years.h: Picture signs to Short Span for Eeeeeeee
years.p: Inverted Audio's reviewer calls the double 12-inch piercing minimal techno and blown-out ambient.
years.xp:
Short Span is run by Matthew Kent out of Sheffield and started in 2025. Kent has said he moved toward dubbier records with long single sides after the pandemic.

Inverted Audio's reviewer reads Eeeeeeee as a record about numbness from the news cycle.

years.src: Album of the Year: Picture, Uuuuuuuu · Resident Advisor: Picture, Uuuuuuuu (review) · Discogs: Picture, Uuuuuuuu · Bandcamp: Picture, Uuuuuuuu
yt: Full stream of Uuuuuuuu on Short Span
years.p: Short Span issues the double 12-inch: seven tracks, 46 minutes. Album of the Year lists Pitchfork's score as 82/100, from reviewer H.D. Angel.
years.xp:
Album of the Year quotes Angel: dub techno at a higher level on an energetic, atmospheric 2x12. RA's Bella Aquilina says there is still evolution inside the framework of dub techno, and hears heavy, crowded arrangements that keep moving.

The tracks are Quuuuuu, Ruuuuu, Miiiiiii, Leeeeeee, Peeeeeee, Ziiiiiiiii and Wooooooo. Mike Grinser mastered it, per Discogs. The artist's Bandcamp line for it is: back with more, still burning.

years.src: Word and Sound: Picture, Yyyyyyyyy · Cold Cuts Hot Wax: Picture, Yyyyyyyyy
years.p: A hand-stamped 12-inch that retailers describe as pristine dub techno in the Basic Channel line.
years.xp: Word and Sound and Cold Cuts Hot Wax both carry it as Picture, P-TON 03, and note Zaks as the Regelbau figure and Danish house producer Central.
